blog_title: The BadPilot campaign: Seashell Blizzard subgroup conducts multiyear global access operation | Microsoft Security Blog
attack_behavior_text: "Since late 2021, the Seashell Blizzard initial access subgroup has primarily deployed web shells following successful exploitation to maintain footholds and achieve the ability to execute commands necessary to deploy secondary tooling to assist lateral movement.
